extraContent.title: Relic Gauge
content: Pathfinders have a special gauge called the Relic Gauge that is used to cast certain Skills. Attacking enemies will charge up your Relic Gauge. At the center of the gauge, there is also a special emblem that changes depending on which the skills you use. Some skills will change depending on what the emblem is
There are three types of emblems (from left to right): Deluge, Burst and Torrent

Additionally, in 2nd Job you will have unlocked your 2 main attacks, <tt src={/class-icons/explorers/pathfinder/cardinal-deluge.png} tip={Cardinal Deluge (1st Job)}> Cardinal Deluge (1st Job) and <tt src={/class-icons/explorers/pathfinder/cardinal-burst.png} tip={Cardinal Burst (2nd Job)}> Cardinal Burst (2nd Job). These two skills can be placed in a skill macro to be used together where Cardinal Burst is placed first and Cardinal Deluge is placed second. Skill macros can be found by pressing a button on the bottom right of the Skill UI

primary.name: Adventurer's Curiosity
primary.shortDesc: Chance to add monsters to Monster Collection: +50%, Critical Rate: +15%, Damage: +6%
details: For Explorer Archers, also permanently increases %Damage
Skill can be found in <tt src={https://grandislibrary.com/class-icons/link-skills/link-manager.png} tip={Link Manager (Beginner Skill)}>
Can be stacked up to 3 times, once for each unique Explorer Archer to reach Master Level

primary.name: Three Snails
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 7, Damage 40
primary.desc: Throws a snail shell forward that deals fixed amount of damage

primary.name: Recovery
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 15, Recover 72 HP over 30 sec

primary.name: Nimble Feet
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 10, Duration 12, Movement Speed: 20

primary.name: Return to Partem
primary.shortDesc: Returns you to Karuppa Town when used.\nCooldown: 600 sec
details: Gained from completing a Pathfinder story quest

primary.name: Ancient Curse
primary.shortDesc:
Level 1: Critical Rate -20%, Defense -20%, Status Resistance -20
Level 2: Defense -20%, Status Resistance -20
Level 3: Status Resistance -20
Level 4: Curse has been lifted
primary.desc: Your stats are reduced due to an unknown curse
details: Effects are reduced upon each Job Advance
Ancient Bow skills do not consume arrow items

primary.name: Hero's Echo
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 30, increases Attack Power & Magic ATT by 4% for 2400 sec\nCooldown: 300 sec
details: To obtain this skill, complete the quest <link href={https://maplestorywiki.net/w/Quests/77/An_Arrangement_from_the_Goddess%2E} title={"An Arrangement from the Goddess"}>
Affects all nearby players

primary.name: Curse Dampening I
primary.shortDesc: Activated when attacking with a Cardinal Force skill. Accumulates up to level 10, with a Critical Rate increase of 2% for each level.\nCan only be activated when the curse is reducing your Critical Rate.
primary.desc: Successful [Cardinal Force] attacks grant a stacking %Crit Rate buff
details: Only active when your %Crit Rate is affected by <tt src={/class-icons/explorers/ancient-curse.png} tip={Ancient Curse (Beginner)}>

primary.name: Cardinal Deluge
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 10, Max Enemies Hit: 4. Blasts an arrow that deals 90% damage 4 times.
primary.desc: Fire several arrows that seek out enemies
details: Changes the emblem at the center of the gauge to 'Deluge'
Prioritizes bosses with the highest HP first
Unaffected by Damage Reflect

[Tip]: In 2nd job, place <tt src={/class-icons/explorers/pathfinder/cardinal-burst.png} tip={Cardinal Burst (2nd)}> first and <tt src={/class-icons/explorers/pathfinder/cardinal-deluge.png} tip={Cardinal Deluge (1st Job)}> second into a skill macro for ease of use<bp_Skill macros is located on a button in the Skill UI on the bottom right_>

primary.name: Double Jump
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 10, allows you to jump a greater distance
primary.desc: Double jump skill
details: Can be assigned a Key Slot or activated by pressing jump twice

While in the air, double-tapping the Up/Down Arrow Key will perform an Up Jump or Down Jump<bp_Right-clicking the skill will toggle a function ON/OFF to perform the jump by pressing Up/Down Arrow Key + Jump Key instead_>

primary.name: Archery Mastery
primary.shortDesc: Range +120, Speed +30, Attack Speed: +1.\nMax Speed Increased to 160

primary.name: Forceful Shot
primary.shortDesc: Critical Rate: +40%

primary.name: Relic Charge I
primary.shortDesc: Relic Gauge Maximum Charge: 1000\nAttacking an enemy with a Cardinal Force skill charges the relic gauge by 10, and by 5 for every guided arrow of Cardinal Deluge that hits an enemy.\nIf a different Cardinal Force skill is used next, the cooldown for all Ancient Force skills will be reduced by 0.5, except for the 5th Job Advancement skills.
primary.desc: Attacking enemies with [Cardinal Force] skills charges the Relic Gauge
details: If the next skill used is a different [Cardinal Force] skill than the one currently used, the cooldown for all [Ancient Force] skills are reduced (except 5th Job Skills)

primary.name: Curse Dampening II
primary.shortDesc: Activated when attacking with a Cardinal Force skill. Accumulates up to level 10, with a Defense increase of 2% for each level.\nCan only be activated when the curse is reducing your Defense.
primary.desc: Successful [Cardinal Force] attacks grant a stacking %DEF buff
details: Only active when your %DEF is affected by <tt src={/class-icons/explorers/ancient-curse.png} tip={Ancient Curse (Beginner)}>

primary.name: Cardinal Deluge Amplification
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 15. Fires an arrow that deals 200% damage to up to 5 enemies 4 times.\nIf a boss monster is within the attack's range, fires 1 additional arrows.
details: Increases %Damage and Max Enemies Hit of attack
If a boss monster is within your attack range, an additional arrow is fired

primary.name: Cardinal Burst
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 15, Max Enemies: 5, Damage: 200%, Attack Count: 4, when the arrow explodes.
primary.desc: Fire an arrow that explodes upon contact with an enemy or maximum range is reached
details: Changes the emblem at the center of the gauge to 'Burst'

[Tip]: Place <tt src={/class-icons/explorers/pathfinder/cardinal-burst.png} tip={Cardinal Burst (2nd)}> first and <tt src={/class-icons/explorers/pathfinder/cardinal-deluge.png} tip={Cardinal Deluge (1st Job)}> second into a skill macro for ease of use<bp_Skill macros is located on a button in the Skill UI on the bottom right_Right-clicking the skill will toggle a function ON/OFF that provides a similar behavior_>

primary.name: Swarm Shot
primary.shortDesc: Relic Gauge Cost: 50, Max Enemies Hit: 8, Damage: 200%, Attack Count: 4. Creates 2 magical arrows that deal 100% damage 4 times each time this attack pierces an enemy.\nCooldown: 5 sec.
primary.desc: Fire an arrow forward that splits upon hitting an enemy and seeks out nearby enemies

primary.name: Relic Jet
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 15, travel a set distance
primary.desc: Dash forward

primary.name: Agile Ancient Bows
primary.shortDesc: Attack Speed: +2, DEX: +20

primary.name: Bountiful Deluge
primary.shortDesc: When using Cardinal Burst while the relic displays the Deluge emblem, there is a 40% chance to create 3 magical arrows.\nThese magical arrows will chase and attack nearby enemies for 2 sec, dealing 100% damage 3 times.
primary.desc: When using <tt src={/class-icons/explorers/pathfinder/cardinal-burst.png} tip={Cardinal Burst (2nd Job)}> while the Relic Gauge is displaying the 'Deluge' emblem, there is a chance to create homing arrows
details: Prioritizes bosses with the highest HP first
Unaffected by Damage Reflect

primary.name: Ancient Bow Mastery
primary.shortDesc: Ancient Bow Mastery: +50%, Attack Power +30

primary.name: Physical Training
primary.shortDesc: Permanently increase STR by 30 and DEX by 30.

primary.name: Curse Dampening III
primary.shortDesc: Activated when attacking with a Cardinal Force skill. Accumulates up to level 10, with a Status Resistance increase of 2% for each level.\nCan only be activated when the curse is reducing your Status Resistance.
primary.desc: Successful [Cardinal Force] attacks grant a stacking Abnormal Status Resistance buff
details: Only active when your Abnormal Status Resistance is affected by <tt src={/class-icons/explorers/ancient-curse.png} tip={Ancient Curse (Beginner)}>

primary.name: Cardinal Burst Boost
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 20, Max Enemies: 6, Damage: 420%, Attack Count: 4, when the arrow explodes.
details: Increases %Damage and Max Enemies Hit of attack

primary.name: Cardinal Torrent
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 20, Consumes 1 Swiftstrike Charge\nDeals 400% damage 5 times to up to 6 nearby enemies.\nYou gain 1 Swiftstrike Charge every 7 sec, and can store up to a maximum of 5.
primary.desc: When used with an Arrow Key, dash in the direction that is pressed
details: If no Arrow Key is pressed, dash in place
Changes the emblem of the Relic Gauge to 'Torrent'
The dash acts as a teleport and can be used to dodge attacks
Uses a special resource called Swiftstrike Charge<bp_Gain one Swiftstrike Charge every 7 secs (up to 5 at a time)_>

primary.name: Triple Impact
primary.shortDesc: Relic Gauge Cost: 50. Explosions deal 265% damage 5 times to up to 4 enemies.\nCooldown 3 sec\n[Passive Effect - Swarm Shot Normal Enemy Damage: +120% points]
primary.desc: Leap into the air and fire 3 exploding arrows downwards
details: [Passive]: Permanently increases %Damage to regular monsters of <tt src={/class-icons/explorers/pathfinder/swarm-shot.png} tip={Swarm Shot (2nd Job)}> by a flat amount
If you are already airborne, the arrows will be fired immediately
While casting, prevents you from being knocked back at all (Super Knockback Resistance)

primary.name: Shadow Raven
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 70, summon a Raven for 600 sec.\nDeals 390% damage to up to 4 enemies at once.\n[Passive Effect: Increases your Defense by 30%]
primary.desc: Summon a raven that fights alongside you
details: [Passive]: Permanently increases %DEF
Unaffected by Damage Reflect

primary.name: Cursebound Endurance
primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 58, increases Status Resistance by 30 for 300 sec. If afflicted by an abnormal status while this skill, Status Resistance will be increased by 20, and can be stacked up to 5 times.\n[Passive Effect: Increases Status Resistance by 30 and all Elemental Resistances by 30%]
primary.desc: Increases Abnormal Status Resistance
details: [Passive]: Permanently increases Abnormal Status Resistance and %Elemental Resistance
While active, when affected by an Abnormal Status, gain a stacking buff of Abnormal Status Resistance

primary.name: Guidance of the Ancients
primary.shortDesc: Each time the Relic Gauge has been filled up by 500, restores HP & MP by 8%.\n[Passive Effect: Increases Max HP by 50% and Final Damage by 28%]
primary.desc: Upon filling the Relic Gauge by set amount, restore some %HP/MP
details: [Passive]: Permanently increases %Final Damage and %Max HP

primary.name: Bountiful Burst
primary.shortDesc: When using Cardinal Deluge while the relic displays the Burst emblem, there is a 40% chance to create 2 magical arrows.\nThese magical arrows will chase nearby enemies for 2 sec and explode on contact, dealing 150% damage to up to 4 enemies 3 times.
primary.desc: When using <tt src={/class-icons/explorers/pathfinder/cardinal-deluge.png} tip={Cardinal Deluge (1st Job)}> while the Relic Gauge is displaying the 'Burst' emblem, there is a chance to create homing arrows
details: Prioritizes bosses with the highest HP first
Unaffected by Damage Reflect

primary.name: Evasion Boost
primary.shortDesc: Dodge Chance: 30%, all attacks following a successful dodge for 1 sec will be critical hits, Knockback Resistance: +40%
primary.desc: Grants a chance to dodge attacks
details: Dodging an attack causes all your attacks to be Critical Hits briefly
Also permanently increases %Knockback Resistance

primary.name: Archer's Essence
primary.shortDesc: Critical Rate: +10%, Damage: +10%, Ignore Defense: +30%

primary.name: Relic Charge II
primary.shortDesc: The Relic Gauge is charged by 20 when attacking an enemy with a Cardinal Force skill, and by 10 per hit from Cardinal Deluge's guided arrows.\nThe Shadow Raven charges the Relic Gauge by 30.
primary.desc: Attacking enemies with [Cardinal Force] skills charges the Relic Gauge
details: [Enchant Force] skills have a different effect based on the emblem displayed on the Relic Gauge<bp_The emblem resets upon using an [Enchant Force] skill_>
Attacks from <tt src={/class-icons/explorers/pathfinder/shadow-raven.png} tip={Shadow Raven (3rd Job)}> also charges the Relic Gauge

primary.name: Curseweaver
primary.shortDesc: Skills that utilize the Ancient Bow deal +10% Critical Damage.

primary.shortDesc: MP Cost: 80, Select a curse to inscribe on Enchant Force\nCooldown: 1 sec
primary.desc: Using the Arrow Keys, choose between Deluge (Up), Burst (Left), or Torrent (Right) to always apply on Enchant Force Skills

primary.name: Advanced Cardinal Force
primary.shortDesc:
When using Cardinal Force skills, MP Cost: 30
Cardinal Deluge
Fires an arrow that deals 273% damage to up to 6 enemies 5 times. Normal Enemy Damage: +27% (additive).
Fires 1 additional arrow if a boss monster is within range. The additional arrow targets the boss with the highest HP first
